description: Common ESP32 development patterns, gotchas, and best practices

common_pitfalls.title: ADC2 + WiFi conflict
common_pitfalls.problem: ADC2 is unavailable when WiFi is active on ESP32/ESP32-S3.
common_pitfalls.fix: Use ADC1 (GPIO 1-10 on ESP32-S3) for analog reads when WiFi is needed.

common_pitfalls.title: PSRAM cache issue
common_pitfalls.problem: On ESP32-S3, flash cache and PSRAM cache share resources. Heavy flash access while PSRAM is in use can cause corruption.
common_pitfalls.fix: Add -mfix-esp32-psram-cache-issue to build flags. In ESP-IDF: configSPIRAM_FETCH_INSTRUCTIONS and SPIRAM_RODATA.

common_pitfalls.title: I2C clock stretching
common_pitfalls.problem: ESP32 hardware I2C has known issues with clock stretching. Some sensors (BME280, CCS811) stretch the clock and cause timeouts.
common_pitfalls.fix: Increase I2C timeout, reduce speed, or use software I2C (bit-bang).

common_pitfalls.title: GPIO interrupt latency
common_pitfalls.problem: ESP32 GPIO interrupts go through a software dispatcher. Latency can be 2-50µs depending on other ISRs.
common_pitfalls.fix: For deterministic sub-microsecond response, use RMT peripheral or dedicated GPIO glitch filter.

common_pitfalls.title: Strapping pins
common_pitfalls.problem: GPIO 0, 46 on ESP32-S3 are strapping pins that control boot mode. Using them as GPIO can prevent boot.
common_pitfalls.fix: Check strapping pin table in datasheet. Never use strapping pins as GPIO in production.

common_pitfalls.title: Deep sleep wake sources
common_pitfalls.problem: Not all GPIOs can wake from deep sleep. Only RTC GPIOs work.
common_pitfalls.fix: Use RTC GPIOs (marked in datasheet) for wake sources. Configure with esp_sleep_enable_ext0_wakeup().

common_pitfalls.title: Watchdog timer resets
common_pitfalls.problem: Long-running operations trigger the Task Watchdog Timer (TWDT) and reset the chip.
common_pitfalls.fix: Call esp_task_wdt_reset() or vTaskDelay(1) in long loops. For long ISRs, disable TWDT or feed it.

power_optimization.notes: CPU paused, RAM retained, wake in ~1ms
Only RTC running, wake on timer/GPIO. RAM lost except RTC slow memory.

build_configs.platformio_minimal:
[env:esp32-s3-devkitc-1]
platform = espressif32
board = esp32-s3-devkitc-1
framework = arduino
monitor_speed = 115200
upload_speed = 921600
board_build.flash_mode = qio
board_build.partitions = default_8MB.csv
build_flags =
    -D CORE_DEBUG_LEVEL=0
    -D BOARD_HAS_PSRAM
    -mfix-esp32-psram-cache-issue
build_configs.idf_minimal:
idf.py set-target esp32s3
idf.py menuconfig  # Enable PSRAM: Component config → ESP PSRAM
idf.py build
idf.py -p /dev/ttyACM0 flash monitor
